  | IdentType.User _ =>
    let o ← entry_impl.get_uuid_init entry

      let o1 ← entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 entry s
      match o1 with
      | none => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
      | some classes =>
        let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes
        let b ← protected.disjoint_protected_entry_classes s1
        if b
        then ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
        else ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
    | some entry_uuid =>
      if entry_uuid <= UUID_ANONYMOUS
      then ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
      else
        let s ←
          lift (Array.to_slice
            (Array.make 5#usize [ 99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8 ]))
        let o1 ← entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 entry s
        match o1 with
        | none => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
        | some classes =>

          let b ← protected.disjoint_protected_entry_classes s1
          if b
          then ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
          else ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
  | IdentType.Synch _ => ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
  | IdentType.Internal ir =>
    match ir with
    | InternalRole.System => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore

      match o with
      | none =>
        let s ←

        let o1 ← entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 entry s
        match o1 with
        | none => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
        | some classes =>
          let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes
          let b ← protected.disjoint_protected_entry_classes s1
          if b
          then ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
          else ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
      | some entry_uuid =>
        if entry_uuid <= UUID_ANONYMOUS
        then ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
        else
          let s ←
            lift (Array.to_slice
              (Array.make 5#usize [ 99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8 ]))

def create_acc.apply_create_access
  (ident : Identity) (related_acp : Slice profiles.AccessControlCreateResolved)
  (entry : Entry) :
  Result create_acc.CreateResult
  := do
  let i ← create_acc.protected_filter_entry ident entry
  let denied ←
    match i with
    | create_acc.IResult.Deny => ok true
    | create_acc.IResult.Grant => ok false
    | create_acc.IResult.Ignore => ok false
    | create_acc.IResult.Allow _ _ => ok false
  let i1 ← create_acc.message_queue ident entry
  let (denied1, grant, allow_pres, allow_pres_cls) ←
    match i1 with
    | create_acc.IResult.Deny =>
      ok (true, false, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | create_acc.IResult.Grant =>
      ok (denied, true, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | create_acc.IResult.Ignore =>
      ok (denied, false, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | create_acc.IResult.Allow pres pres_cls =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres
      let allow_pres1 ←
        bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_cls
      let allow_pres_cls1 ←
        bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s1
      ok (denied, false, allow_pres1, allow_pres_cls1)
  let i2 ← create_acc.migration_filter_entry ident entry
  let (denied2, grant1, allow_pres1, allow_pres_cls1) ←
    match i2 with
    | create_acc.IResult.Deny => ok (true, grant, allow_pres, allow_pres_cls)
    | create_acc.IResult.Grant =>
      ok (denied1, true, allow_pres, allow_pres_cls)
    | create_acc.IResult.Ignore =>
      ok (denied1, grant, allow_pres, allow_pres_cls)
    | create_acc.IResult.Allow pres pres_cls =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres
      let allow_pres2 ← bset.extend allow_pres s
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_cls
      let allow_pres_cls2 ← bset.extend allow_pres_cls s1
      ok (denied1, grant, allow_pres2, allow_pres_cls2)
  let i3 ← create_acc.create_filter_entry ident related_acp entry
  let (denied3, grant2, allow_pres2, allow_pres_cls2) ←
    match i3 with
    | create_acc.IResult.Deny =>
      ok (true, grant1, allow_pres1, allow_pres_cls1)
    | create_acc.IResult.Grant =>
      ok (denied2, true, allow_pres1, allow_pres_cls1)
    | create_acc.IResult.Ignore =>
      ok (denied2, grant1, allow_pres1, allow_pres_cls1)
    | create_acc.IResult.Allow pres pres_cls =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres
      let allow_pres3 ← bset.extend allow_pres1 s
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_cls
      let allow_pres_cls3 ← bset.extend allow_pres_cls1 s1
      ok (denied2, grant1, allow_pres3, allow_pres_cls3)
  if denied3
  then ok create_acc.CreateResult.Deny
  else
    if grant2
    then ok create_acc.CreateResult.Grant
    else
      let i4 := alloc.vec.Vec.len (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
      let allowed_pres ←
        if i4 != 0#usize
        then
          let s :=
            alloc.vec.Vec.deref (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
          let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allow_pres2
          bset.intersection s s1
        else ok allow_pres2
      let i5 := alloc.vec.Vec.len (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
      let allowed_pres_cls ←
        if i5 != 0#usize
        then
          let s :=
            alloc.vec.Vec.deref (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
          let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allow_pres_cls2
          bset.intersection s s1
        else ok allow_pres_cls2
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allowed_pres_cls
      let allowed_pres_cls1 ← protected.remove_protected_mod_pres s
      ok (create_acc.CreateResult.Allow allowed_pres allowed_pres_cls1)

def create_acc.migration_filter_entry
  (ident : Identity) (entry : Entry) : Result create_acc.IResult := do
  match ident.origin with
  | IdentType.User _ => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
  | IdentType.Synch _ => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
  | IdentType.Internal ir =>
    match ir with
    | InternalRole.System => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore

      let s ←

      let o ← entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 entry s
      match o with
      | none => ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
      | some classes =>
        let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes
        let classes1 ← migration.sub_migration_ignore s1
        let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes1
        let b ← migration.subset_migration_entry s2
        if b
        then
          let s3 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes1
          let (allow_attrs, allow_cls) ← migration.migration_entry_attrs s3
          let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len allow_attrs
          if i = 0#usize
          then ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
          else ok (create_acc.IResult.Allow allow_attrs allow_cls)
        else ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
    | InternalRole.AccountRequest => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
    | InternalRole.MessageQueue => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore

-- then supplies their hypotheses for every child of a filter.
theorem match_any_total (e : Entry) (l : alloc.vec.Vec FilterResolved)
    (hs : ∀ f ∈ l.val, entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e f ⦃ _ => True ⦄)
    (i : Usize) : entry_impl.match_any e l i ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  induction hm : l.val.length - i.val using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [entry_impl.match_any]
    split
    · simp
    · step
      step with hs fr (by rw [fr_post]; exact List.getElem_mem _)
      split
      · simp
      · step
        exact ih (l.val.length - i2.val) (by scalar_tac) i2 rfl

    entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e f ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  refine FilterResolved.rec
    (motive_1 := fun f => entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e f ⦃ _ => True ⦄)
    (motive_2 := fun l => ∀ f ∈ l.val,
      entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e f ⦃ _ => True ⦄)
    (motive_3 := fun s => ∀ f ∈ s.val,
      entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e f ⦃ _ => True ⦄)
    (motive_4 := fun _ l => ∀ f ∈ l.toList,
      entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e f ⦃ _ => True ⦄)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ f
  · intro attr pv; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro attr pv; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro attr pv; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro attr pv; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro attr; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro attr pv; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro l ih; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; exact match_any_total e l ih _
  · intro l ih; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; exact match_all_total e l ih _
  · intro attr; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; simp
  · intro l ih; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; simp
  · intro f ih; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step with ih
  · intro s ih; exact ih
  · intro n l bound ih; exact ih
  · simp [Data.ListN.ListN.toList]

theorem protected_deny_overrides_create (ident : Identity)
    (related : Slice profiles.AccessControlCreateResolved) (e : Entry)
    (h : create_acc.protected_filter_entry ident e = ok .Deny) :
    create_acc.apply_create_access ident related e = ok .Deny := by
  rcases ident with ⟨origin, scope⟩
  cases origin with
  | User u =>
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := ok_of (create_user_total u scope related e)
    have hs := post_of_ok (create_user_total u scope related e) hr
    cases r <;> simp_all [create_acc.apply_create_access, create_acc.message_queue,
      create_acc.migration_filter_entry]
  | Synch uuid =>
    simp [create_acc.apply_create_access, h, create_acc.message_queue,
      create_acc.migration_filter_entry, create_acc.create_filter_entry]
  | Internal role =>
    cases role with
    | System => simp [create_acc.protected_filter_entry] at h
    | AccountRequest => simp [create_acc.protected_filter_entry] at h
    | MessageQueue => simp [create_acc.protected_filter_entry] at h
    | Migration =>
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := ok_of (migration_total scope e)
      apply eq_ok_of_spec
      simp only [create_acc.apply_create_access, h, bind_tc_ok,
        create_acc.message_queue, create_acc.create_filter_entry, hr]
      cases r <;> h5i_steps

    (motive_2 := fun l => ∀ f ∈ l.val,
      entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e f ⦃ _ => True ⦄)
    (motive_3 := fun s => ∀ f ∈ s.val,
      entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e f ⦃ _ => True ⦄)
    (motive_4 := fun _ l => ∀ f ∈ l.toList,
      entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e f ⦃ _ => True ⦄)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ f
  · intro attr pv; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro attr pv; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro attr pv; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro attr pv; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro attr; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro attr pv; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step*
  · intro l ih; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; exact match_any_total e l ih _
  · intro l ih; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; exact match_all_total e l ih _
  · intro attr; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; simp
  · intro l ih; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; simp
  · intro f ih; rw [entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner]; step with ih
  · intro s ih; exact ih
  · intro n l bound ih; exact ih
  · simp [Data.ListN.ListN.toList]
  · intro n f l hf hl
    simpa only [Data.ListN.ListN.toList, List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp] using And.intro hf hl

@[step] theorem migration_attrs_bound (classes : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) :
    migration.migration_entry_attrs classes ⦃ r =>
      r.1.val.length ≤ 64 ∧ r.2.val.length ≤ 64 ⦄ := by
  have hmax := usize_max_ge
  unfold migration.migration_entry_attrs
  -- Merge each optional class branch with a length bound, keeping later
  -- insertions below the vector capacity without enumerating combinations.
  step*
  apply WP.spec_bind (Pₘ := fun r : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) => r.val.length ≤ 6)
  · h5i_steps <;> scalar_tac
  · intro attrs2 h2
    step*
    apply WP.spec_bind (Pₘ := fun r : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) ×
        alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) => r.1.val.length ≤ 11 ∧ r.2.val.length ≤ 3)
    · h5i_steps <;> scalar_tac
    · rintro ⟨attrs3, cls3⟩ ⟨h3, hc3⟩
      step*
      apply WP.spec_bind (Pₘ := fun r : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) ×
          alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) => r.1.val.length ≤ 19 ∧ r.2.val.length ≤ 3)
      · h5i_steps
        all_goals (simp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd, alloc.vec.Vec.new, alloc.vec.Vec.from_val,
          List.length_nil] at *; omega)
      · rintro ⟨attrs4, cls4⟩ ⟨h4, hc4⟩
        step*
        apply WP.spec_bind (Pₘ := fun r : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) ×
            alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) => r.1.val.length ≤ 25 ∧ r.2.val.length ≤ 3)
        · h5i_steps <;> scalar_tac
        · rintro ⟨attrs5, cls5⟩ ⟨h5, hc5⟩
          step*
          apply WP.spec_bind (Pₘ := fun r : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8) => r.val.length ≤ 33)
          · h5i_steps <;> scalar_tac
          · intro attrs6 h6
            h5i_steps
            all_goals (simp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd, alloc.vec.Vec.new, alloc.vec.Vec.from_val,
              List.length_nil] at *; omega)

theorem protected_deny_overrides_create (ident : Identity)
    (related : Slice profiles.AccessControlCreateResolved) (e : Entry)
    (h : create_acc.protected_filter_entry ident e = ok .Deny) :
    create_acc.apply_create_access ident related e = ok .Deny := by
  rcases ident with ⟨origin, scope⟩
  cases origin with
  | User u =>
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := ok_of (create_user_total u scope related e)
    have hs := post_of_ok (create_user_total u scope related e) hr
    cases r <;> simp_all [create_acc.apply_create_access, create_acc.message_queue,
      create_acc.migration_filter_entry]
  | Synch uuid =>
    simp [create_acc.apply_create_access, h, create_acc.message_queue,
      create_acc.migration_filter_entry, create_acc.create_filter_entry]
  | Internal role =>
    cases role with
    | System => simp [create_acc.protected_filter_entry] at h
    | AccountRequest => simp [create_acc.protected_filter_entry] at h
    | MessageQueue => simp [create_acc.protected_filter_entry] at h
    | Migration =>
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := ok_of (migration_total scope e)
      apply eq_ok_of_spec
      simp only [create_acc.apply_create_access, h, bind_tc_ok,
        create_acc.message_queue, create_acc.create_filter_entry, hr]
      cases r <;> h5i_steps
